postings.title: Senior RF Test Engineer
top_requirements: Perform hands‑on over‑the‑air (OTA) measurements and calibrations using RF chamber equipment such as R&S and Bluetest systems.
Develop and execute test plans for RF front‑end hardware, including call‑box and antenna‑port verification.
Troubleshoot and repair RF modules at the board level, including solder rework and component level diagnostics.
postings.summary: The role focuses on RF hardware test and validation for defense‑related systems, providing extensive hands‑on measurement work that matches the candidate’s RF test background. It is a senior‑level test engineering position with direct hardware interaction.

postings.title: Senior RF Test Engineer
top_requirements: Execute OTA chamber measurements and characterize RF passive/active components such as filters, amplifiers, and splitters.
Develop and maintain test fixtures and call‑box setups for high‑frequency hardware verification.
Perform detailed solder‑rework and mechanical assembly troubleshooting on RF boards.
postings.summary: A senior RF test engineer role that emphasizes hands‑on OTA testing and component validation, aligning well with the candidate’s extensive RF test experience. The position offers a solid senior technical contribution.

postings.title: Senior RF Filter Design Engineer
top_requirements: Design and optimize resonant acoustic‑wave and RF filters for 5G/6G and Wi‑Fi applications using 3‑D electromagnetic simulation tools.
Create and validate filter models in proprietary XBAR® software and verify performance against silicon measurements.
Collaborate with layout and silicon teams to translate filter specifications into production‑ready mask data.
postings.summary: The position involves hands‑on RF filter design for next‑generation wireless chips, a natural extension of the candidate’s RF communications background while moving toward IC‑centric work. It is a senior engineering role at a fast‑moving tech company.

postings.title: Senior RF Engineer (Design)
top_requirements: Lead end‑to‑end design of high‑performance RF modules, from system specification through schematic capture, layout, and prototype validation.
Perform RF link‑budget analysis, EVM testing, and compliance verification for communication radios.
Transfer validated designs to manufacturing, creating test procedures and documentation for volume production.
postings.summary: Senior RF engineer role focused on hands‑on RF module design and production transfer, directly leveraging the candidate’s satellite communications and modem design experience while moving into a commercial IC environment.

postings.title: Lead RFIC & Analog Design Engineer
top_requirements: Design and prototype RFIC blocks (e.g., LNAs, mixers, VCOs) in a 65 nm‑plus CMOS process, delivering silicon‑level performance targets.
Create and verify layout using advanced analog/RF layout tools, ensuring compliance with matching and isolation requirements.
Lead cross‑functional sign‑off activities, including silicon validation, yield analysis, and documentation for volume production.
postings.summary: A senior RFIC and analog design position that emphasizes hands‑on circuit design and layout, perfectly aligned with the candidate’s goal of moving into senior IC roles.

postings.title: Senior RF Integration Engineer – RFSOI & 3DIC Platforms
top_requirements: Develop and verify RF‑SOI and RF‑SOI‑3DIC platform designs, including device modeling, test‑structure creation, and silicon validation.
Collaborate with customers to define platform specifications and ensure successful qualification of new process nodes.
Perform measurement campaigns using network analyzers and spectrum analyzers to characterize RF performance across process corners.
bonus_skills: Scripting in MATLAB/Python for data analysis
postings.summary: A senior engineering role focused on RF‑SOI platform development, providing hands‑on device and circuit validation that aligns with the candidate’s RF design background while moving toward semiconductor‑level work.
